# Codex Chronicle

### Local history. Shared context. Deliberate export.

---

A local-first development journal and project-memory service for coding agents. The local journal, collector/API and optional publisher have separate responsibilities.

| Delivery | Memory | Control |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Persistent outbox, retries and idempotency | Structured project context and immutable revisions | Explicit export policy and scoped credentials |

**Preview release.** Live-service, cross-platform and long-running acceptance work is still open. Local/mock checks should not be confused with completed real-provider end-to-end validation.

[Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [API](../docs/API.md) · [Operations](../docs/OPERATIONS.md) · [Acceptance status](../ACCEPTANCE_STATUS.md)

The detailed README also describes ongoing integration work on the `master` branch; use the documentation corresponding to the branch you run.
